back: Problem: what hurts, with numbers. Solution: how you'd fix it. Ask about the problem first.
Specific, measurable, has a baseline and a measurement method.
Goals, diagram, data model, API, AI components, hosting, cost, risks/SPOFs, out of scope, task plan.
Single point of failure: one component whose failure stops the system. List with mitigations.

front: Task for an AI agent needs?
back: Objective, files/constraints, and a checkable done condition. One small PR each.
Tests and a 'How I verified this' section; author can explain every line.
Restate need → impact (scope/time/cost/risk) → options → recommendation → ask for written decision.
Security, AI safety/evals, quality, performance, deploy, operations, backups, rollback, privacy.
Weakened checks, edited tests, swallowed errors, string SQL, widened CORS, new deps, unrelated refactors.
README (local vs deploy), architecture, API, runbook, known limits, cost, AI section.
